name: fyndr
description: Fyndr — Event photo sharing with face recognition (one-command dev)

scripts.dev: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('logs',{recursive:true})" && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d mongo --wait && concurrently --names "api,ml,web" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta,green" "npm:dev:api 2>&1 | tee logs/api.log" "npm:dev:ml 2>&1 | tee logs/ml.log" "npm:dev:web 2>&1 | tee logs/web.log"
scripts.dev:ml: cd flask-server-2 && venv\Scripts\python.exe app.py || cd flask-server-2 && venv/bin/python app.py
scripts.setup: npm install --prefix node-server-1 && npm install --prefix front-end && python -m venv flask-server-2/venv && flask-server-2/venv/Scripts/pip install -r flask-server-2/requirements.txt
scripts.compose:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml down
